description: A ball-and-stick molecular model of the ethyl group (C₂H₅). Carbon atoms represented as larger balls, hydrogen atoms as smaller balls, with cylindrical sticks representing covalent bonds. Atom sizes and bond lengths scaled appropriately to standard ball-and-stick conventions. Atoms colored using standard CPK color scheme: carbon atoms in black or dark gray, hydrogen atoms in white.
